meta.source: Synced to theme/simply-nova/assets/css/tokens.css in simplynova754/snn-custom (19 Oct 2026); the theme is the master copy.

tokens.name: sn-cream
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere. Also the on-color for text on teal and clay fills.

tokens.name: sn-raised
tokens.usage: The only raised surface: product tickets, primer terms, portions strip, buy panel, reviews, pair cards, calculator output.

tokens.name: sn-alt
tokens.usage: Bone. A cream tint for alternating rows only; no interactive role. Muted ink on bone is 4.0:1 and fails AA at small sizes: use full espresso ink on it.

tokens.name: sn-espresso
tokens.usage: Ink for body text and structure on cream (13.5:1). The only other surface: footer, selected toggles and tabs.

tokens.name: sn-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, eyebrows, captions, ledes on cream (4.6:1) and white (4.8:1). Not on bone.

tokens.name: sn-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (2.7:1 — fails as text by design). The mockups also use it for per-pound price, dt labels and review bylines; those uses break the ruling and should move to sn-ink-muted.

tokens.name: sn-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, wells and selectors at rest. Decorative (1.25:1); never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: sn-rule
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline under the nav and between every section and product-page module; note and constraint left rules; scale tracks.

tokens.name: sn-status-bg
tokens.usage: Image-well fill, absent/sold-out chip fill, disabled primary button fill.

tokens.name: sn-status-ink
tokens.usage: Text on absent chips (7.3:1 on status-bg).

tokens.name: sn-btn2-border
tokens.usage: Secondary button, mode toggle, stepper and segmented borders at rest. 1.6:1 — below the 3:1 control-border floor; flagged.

tokens.name: sn-cream-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on espresso (7.4:1) and the utility bar copy on teal (4.1:1 — fails at 12px; flagged).

tokens.name: sn-cream-faint
tokens.usage: Ticker separators and pill labels on espresso (3.9:1): decoration only.

tokens.name: sn-border-onink
tokens.usage: Hairlines on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-rule-onink
tokens.usage: Rules and secondary-button borders on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-well-onink
tokens.usage: Image-well fill on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-teal
tokens.usage: Rest state of everything interactive on light grounds: links, nav items, primary button fill (6.7:1 on cream). Cream text on it is 6.7:1.

tokens.name: sn-teal-onink
tokens.usage: Rest-state interactive on espresso only (6.5:1). Never used on light grounds; sn-teal never used on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Heading ink for H1, H2 and H3 on light grounds (8.3:1), ratified Sep 2026. Not for links or buttons.

tokens.name: sn-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Declared in the token block; no use in either mockup yet.

tokens.name: sn-clay
tokens.usage: Interaction only: hover, focus and active on every control, and hover ink on links (5.3:1 on cream). Never a rest state.

tokens.name: sn-hover-ink
tokens.usage: Alias. Text and underline color on hover/focus.

tokens.name: sn-heading
tokens.usage: H1, H2, H3 on light grounds. Headings on espresso stay sn-cream.

tokens.name: sn-heading-product
tokens.usage: Product-page H1 only, teal to match the Add to ticket button (decisions log, Sep 2026). On espresso it is cream.

tokens.name: sn-nav-ink
tokens.usage: Nav items at rest. Teal like every other link.

tokens.name: sn-nav-current
tokens.usage: Current page in the nav: same teal, marked by a 2px teal underline (sn-nav-current-rule) rather than a colour change.

tokens.name: sn-nav-current-rule
tokens.usage: The 2px underline under the current nav item.

tokens.name: sn-nav-hover
tokens.usage: Nav item text and underline on hover and focus.

tokens.name: sn-nav-kicker
tokens.usage: Caveat script kicker above a nav item ("local", "NYC", "the blog"), teal at rest, clay on hover (12 Oct 2026).

tokens.name: sn-nav-mega-link
tokens.usage: Mega-menu links and feature captions at rest.

tokens.name: sn-nav-mega-head
tokens.usage: Mega-menu column heads ("Appetizing Counter").

tokens.name: sn-nav-footer-link
tokens.usage: Footer links on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-nav-footer-head
tokens.usage: Footer column heads on espresso.

tokens.name: sn-nav-crumb
tokens.usage: Breadcrumb links.

tokens.name: sn-clay-focus
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline, 3px, offset 2px.

tokens.name: sn-clay-tint
tokens.usage: Scarcity chip fill only ("Two left for Sunday"). Never on anything clickable.

tokens.name: sn-clay-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the scarcity chip (7.8:1 on clay-tint).

tokens.name: sn-scrim
tokens.usage: Page scrim behind the open mega menu.

tokens.name: sn-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow ink for the buy panel and floating controls.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: CUT BY HAND, THE WAY IT WAS.
styles.usage: Homepage hero H1. Uppercase. clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px).

styles.name: display-catering
styles.usage: Catering headline with inline photo tiles. clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 74px).

styles.name: display-statement
styles.sample: A SLICE THIS THIN ONLY HAPPENS BY HAND.
styles.usage: Statement module, centred, max 20ch. clamp(30px, 4.6vw, 58px).

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: PICK THE TABLE, NOT THE FISH.
styles.usage: Homepage section H2. clamp(32px, 4.2vw, 54px).

styles.name: display-pdp
styles.usage: Product page H1, in sn-heading-product (teal). clamp(34px, 4.1vw, 52px).

styles.name: display-module
styles.usage: Product-page module H2. clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 44px).

styles.name: display-card
styles.usage: Ticket and primer-term H3. Rail items 24px, lineup 23px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Nav wordmark (footer: 32px). Set in type; there is no web logo file yet.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: An appetizing shop on Metropolitan Avenue.
styles.usage: Hero sub, max 38ch, sn-ink-muted.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: When people come in, the first thing they say is, this reminds me of my childhood.
styles.usage: Press pull quote. clamp(21px, 2.3vw, 28px). No fourth face for quotes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything is sliced the morning it goes out.
styles.usage: Default copy. 16px is the ratified floor for body text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: What is the difference between nova and lox?
styles.usage: FAQ questions.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav items, category tile labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button (700). Secondary uses 500.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Nova, a half dozen bagels, cream cheese, tomato, onion, capers.
styles.usage: Card lines, claims, review body. Below the ratified 16px floor; flagged.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on tickets and the PDP. Mono is for shop data: prices, weights, addresses, cure methods.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Portions strip figures.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Footer address block.

styles.name: ticker
styles.usage: Utility bar and promise line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips (uppercase, .08em), ticket stubs, cure lines, crumbs (.06–.1em).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows and column heads, uppercase, sn-ink-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kickers above nav items and single-line asides only, lowercase, sized relative to the text it sits on. Never for body copy, headings or buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Swatch and size grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button pairs, tile label gap, buy-action stack.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Eyebrow bottom margin, rail-item gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Category tile and pair grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Ticket inner padding, buy-panel block padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Ticket, rail and primer grid gutters; portion padding.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Nav item gap.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Footer and mega-menu column gaps.

tokens.name: space-42
tokens.usage: Section head to content.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; buy-block column gap.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero and story column gap.

tokens.name: space-76
tokens.usage: Product-page module padding.

tokens.name: space-88
tokens.usage: Homepage section padding (hero 84 top / 88 bottom).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips, focus outline.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Tabs, swatch chips.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, feature tiles.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Swatches, amount buttons, mode toggle, stepper, segments, gallery thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Image wells, tickets, primer grid, portions.

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Gallery stage, reviews, pair cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Buy panel, taste profile, calculator output.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Use-chips, floating switchers.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The buy panel only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating controls over content.

tokens.name: wrap
tokens.usage: Content width: min(1180px, 92vw).

tokens.name: narrow
tokens.usage: Statement and long-read width.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header height.

tokens.name: utility-height
tokens.usage: Utility bar height.

tokens.name: buybar-height
tokens.usage: Sticky buy bar height.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap height for every interactive element (ratified).

tokens.name: breakpoint
tokens.usage: The one layout breakpoint; 400px for small phones.
